title: Cherry Flambe Italian Dessert
description: A unique Italian dessert recipe featuring cherry flambe, combining sweet and tangy flavors.
instructions: Rinse the cherries and remove stems.
Mix together sugar, flambe, and vanilla extract in a bowl.
Add the cherry mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with prik and yummy (if using).
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cherries are tender.
Serve warm, topped with a scoop of ice cream or whipped cream (optional).
If using frozen cherries, thaw and pat dry with paper towels before using.
Adjust the amount of flambe to your taste for a stronger or milder flavor.
